watches.name: J.Ciro S3 Panda Chronograph Watch
watches.description: S3 Panda Chronograph: A Bold Fusion of Classic and Modern Design Introducing the S3 Panda Chronograph, a fresh take on two of our most popular models—the white dial and reverse panda. Both were instant sell-outs, and now, this stunning new combination is here to continue the legacy. Featuring a textured white main dial with striking black sub-dials and vibrant blue accents, this timepiece is a perfect blend of timeless design and contemporary flair. Paired with a black leather strap with blue stitching, the S3 Panda Chronograph is destined to become a fan favorite. Why You’ll Love It: Iconic Design: The bold contrast of the white dial with black sub-dials and blue accents creates a visually captivating timepiece. Durable and Reliable: Crafted with a 42mm 316L stainless steel case and a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating for maximum protection and clarity. Precision Engineering: Powered by the Seiko VK67 Meca-Quartz Chronograph movement for accurate and dependable performance. Comfortable Elegance: The black leather strap with blue stitching adds a modern touch, featuring a quick-release system for effortless customization. Glow Anywhere: Swiss BGW9 Super Luminova on the hands ensures visibility in any lighting condition. Key Specifications: Case Size: 42mm (10.7mm thick) Lug to Lug: 51mm Water Resistance: 5 ATM (splash and rain resistant) Dial: Textured white with black sub-dials and blue accents for a striking aesthetic Crystal: Sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating for durability and clarity Movement: Seiko VK67 Meca-Quartz Chronograph for precise and reliable timekeeping Caseback: Engraved screw-down caseback for added detail and durability Strap: Black leather with blue stitching, stainless buckle, and quick-release functionality Service & Assurance: Two-Year Manufacturer’s Warranty for worry-free ownership Superior Craftsmanship: Designed to deliver both style and performance The S3 Panda Chronograph is more than just a watch—it’s a statement of style, precision, and individuality. Whether you’re adding to your collection or looking for a standout piece, this chronograph is designed to impress.

watches.name: Legacy Teal Dress Watch
watches.description: Legacy Teal Dress Watch: Timeless Elegance for Life’s Defining Moments The Legacy Teal Dress Watch is more than just a timepiece—it’s a celebration of life’s most meaningful milestones. Whether it’s a job interview, a first date, a wedding day, or an evening out, this watch is designed to complement every moment that adds to your legacy. With its classic, clean design and customizable features, the Legacy Teal Dress Watch is the perfect blend of sophistication and personalization. Why It’s Special: Elegant and Versatile Design: The textured teal dial and sleek stainless steel case create a timeless look that pairs effortlessly with any outfit. Customizable Options: Choose between two exceptional movements: Swiss Ronda Quartz (Battery-Powered): Reliable and precise for minimal maintenance. Japanese Miyota 8315 Automatic (Powered by Movement): A self-winding movement with a 60-hour power reserve, hacking seconds, and 21 jewels for superior craftsmanship. Premium Strap Choices: Select from a fitted metal 3-link bracelet or a high-quality hand-stitched light brown leather strap for personalized comfort and style. Built to Last: Crafted with 316L stainless steel, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, and water resistance up to 10 ATM. Key Specifications: Case Size: 41mm (10.7mm thick for Quartz, 12mm thick for Automatic) Lug to Lug: 48mm Water Resistance: 10 ATM (suitable for everyday wear, including swimming) Dial: Textured teal for a bold yet refined aesthetic Crystal: Scratch-free sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating for clarity and durability Movement Options: Quartz: Swiss Ronda for reliable, battery-powered precision Automatic: Miyota 8315 with a 60-hour power reserve and hand-winding capability Caseback: Quartz: Engraved screw-down caseback Automatic: Exhibition (see-through) screw-down caseback Service & Assurance: Two-Year Manufacturer’s Warranty for peace of mind Superior Customer Support: Fast response times and personalized assistance Quick Shipping: Orders ship within 1-2 business days (except during pre-order phases) Hassle-Free Returns: 14-day return policy for worry-free shopping The Legacy Teal Dress Watch is more than just a watch—it’s a companion for life’s most significant moments. With its timeless design, customizable features, and exceptional craftsmanship, this watch is designed to leave a lasting impression.

watches.name: J.Ciro Ambassador Steel White Dress Watch
watches.description: Used informally, an 'Ambassador' is one who represents another. In the case of J.Ciro Designs' first watch collection, the Ambassador Timepieces are entrusted to be representatives of both style and class. The Ambassador is available in three finishes (stainless steel, rose gold, black), each with the option of a black or white brushed dial. The Ambassador Steel White features our stainless steel case, signature blue second hand, white brushed dual-layered dial, and a single date window. Choose from a variety of leather, silicone, or stainless steel band options. Specifications: Steel 42mm Case with Fixed Bezel & Steel Onion Crown Brushed, Dual Layered Dial with Roman Numerals and minute indexes Quartz Movement Matching Hour and Minute Hands, J.Ciro Signature Blue Second Hand Single Date Window Water Resistant - 5 ATM Screw-in Case Back
